controls.name: Design and independent change review
controls.scope: Consequential designs, implementation, tests, delegation and exceptions.
controls.mechanism: Lead owns design/integration and verifies returned evidence; at most two workers use separate project-local worktrees and named disjoint paths, with shared runtime serialized; fresh-context review assesses contracts, risk and maintainability before acceptance. Review new or expanded custom infrastructure across code/docs/workflow/controls against S-CODE: name the existing option, unmet gap, smallest scope, owner/cost and retirement trigger; reject unjustified duplication. Before publication, inspect explicit Git author/committer identities and all new commit messages, including co-author trailers, under S-WORK. Use repository-local Git identity configuration. Before merging a PR whose Issue completion awaits merged-main validation, read gh pr view --json closingIssuesReferences, require an empty list and re-read after removing references. Prose negation is not a parser control; use GitHub computed data, no custom keyword parser. For source-dependent consequential claims, inspect executable predicates, caller cadence, units and defaults against actual outcomes; preserve mistaken rationale and which actions preceded correction. For changed native boundaries, compare synthetic category/action/row/transition assumptions with the pinned producer and retained visible frames; reject fictional UI labels used to arm control state. Reuse the existing regression/native lanes; do not infer native support from passing mocks. Development-first delivery places cohesive independent implementation/test/evidence review at integration/acceptance; consequential new boundaries retain earlier design/risk review. No routine readiness reviewer or per-action critic is added to ordinary development play. A complete unchanged unassisted development run can support its prospective functional outcome after exact-source checks/review; it is never retroactively relabeled held-out evidence. Review selection follows the decision-and-risk guidance in docs/project-management.md: choose applicable product/player/observer/architecture/research perspectives rather than every lens for every change. For consequential input/memory/learning/autonomy changes, verify the prior-document and research crosswalk required by S-ARCH, including conflicts and transfer limits. Independent proxy review does not establish real-user usability or semantic truth; no new automated semantic checker is added. For agent/memory changes, check S-ARCH's active/background ownership, automatic-versus-model feedback, attribution and revisable-advice boundaries; gameplay independence review checks that routine reasoning/curation does not depend on the engineering lead. This adds no per-action approval. At meaningful discussion/research/review/delivery checkpoints, check S-WORK action-item dispositions in the existing Issues/Project and applicable updates to authoritative principles, standards, controls and guidance; proposals and filed findings are not completed behavior.
controls.trigger: significant change, new boundary/guarantee/dependency or integration checkpoint
controls.failure_response: Resolve material findings or record scoped owner/reason/revisit exception; after two unsuccessful worker repairs lead takes back the work.
controls.limitations: No code checker proves reasoning quality, typing completeness, decomposition or delegation compliance; independence depends on the actual review process. Reuse fit and the adequacy of its rationale are semantic judgments; CI does not prove them. Identity configuration prevents inferred defaults but does not inspect file contents or prove a message, branch or remote ref contains no personal information; full-message inspection remains manual. Fixture realism is a manual source/evidence judgment; common tests cannot prove it. No automated check proves that discussion/research findings are fully represented in the backlog or correctly reconciled into authoritative artifacts.
controls.enforcement: Required by S-AGENT and the GitHub work/PR workflow; independent agent review is manually recorded, not an independent GitHub human approval. Hosted enforcement is recorded separately in acceptance.

controls.enforcement: Common command fails on renderer errors, missing title/description/ID or changed input/output receipts; negative fixtures include a real parse failure. No global installation or automatic fetch.
controls.rationale: Required to keep user-facing visual explanations reviewable and synchronized.
